project.name: shopfront
project.summary: Next.js app (App Router) with Server Actions and route handlers; Prisma (postgresql); deployed on Vercel

full_suite.note: fine to run, but prefer targeted files while iterating

data.check_command: npx prisma validate && npx prisma migrate status

house_rules: Every Server Action and route handler checks the session and ownership itself; middleware is not an authorization layer.
Prisma queries returned to the client use select; never return whole models.
Validate all inputs with zod schemas from src/lib/validation.
